Bank-Special-75.question: ৫) The equation 12x<sup>2</sup> + 4kx + 3 = 0 has real and equal roots, if-
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: The equation 12x2 + 4kx + 3 = 0 has real and equal roots, if-

Solution:
Here a = 12, b = 4k, c = 3
Since the given equation has real and equal roots
∴ b2 - 4ac = 0
⇒ (4k)2 - 4 × 12 × 3 = 0
⇒ 16k2 - 144 = 0
⇒ 16k2 = 144
⇒ k2 = 9
⇒ k = ± 3

Question: Evaluate the compound interest on Tk. 10101 for 3 years at the rate of 9% per annum compounded annually.

Solution:
A = P (1 + R/100)n
⇒ A = 10101(1 + 9/100)3 = 10101(109/100)3 = 13081.08

C.I. = A - P = 13081.08 - 10101 = 2980.08.

Bank-Special-75.question: ১১) Calculate the compound interest at the rate of 6% per annum for 2 years on the principal, which in 2 years at the rate of 2% per annum gives Tk. 8000 as simple interest.
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: Calculate the compound interest at the rate of 6% per annum for 2 years on the principal, which in 2 years at the rate of 2% per annum gives Tk. 8000 as simple interest.

Solution:
S.I. = PRT/100
⇒ P = (S.I. × 100) / (R × T)
∴ P = (8000 × 100)/(2 × 2) = 200000

A = 200000(1 + 6/100)2 = 200000(53/50)2 = 224720

C.I. = 224720 - 200000 = 24720.

Bank-Special-75.question: ১৩) What is the value of the lesser root of the equation x<sup>2</sup> - 3x + 2 = 0?
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: What is the value of the lesser root of the equation x2 - 3x + 2 = 0?

Solution:
x2 - 3x + 2 = 0
⇒ x2 - 2x - x + 2 = 0
⇒ x(x - 2) - 1(x - 2)= 0
⇒ (x - 1)(x - 2) = 0
so the solutions to the equation are x1 = 1, x2 = 2.
The lesser one is obviously 1.

Bank-Special-75.question: ১৫) If x - 1/x = √5, then x + 1/x =?
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: If x - 1/x = √5, then x + 1/x =?

Solution:
Given,
x - 1/x = √5

We know,
(x + 1/x)2 = (x - 1/x)2 + 4x.1/x
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = ( √5)2 + 4 
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = 5 + 4 
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = 9 
⇒ (x + 1/x) = √9
∴ (x + 1/x) = 3

Bank-Special-75.question: ১৮) The equation (x - 2)<sup>2</sup> + 1 = 2x - 3 is a-
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: The equation (x - 2)2 + 1 = 2x - 3 is a-

Solution:
We have (x - 2)2 + 1 = 2x - 3
⇒ x2 + 4 - 2 × x × 2 + 1 = 2x - 3
⇒ x2 - 4x + 5 - 2x + 3 = 0
∴ x2 - 6x + 8 = 0, which is a quadratic equation.

Bank-Special-75.question: ১৯) Mary is 16 years old. She is 4 times older than her brother. How old will Mary be when she is twice his age?
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: Mary is 16 years old. She is 4 times older than her brother. How old will Mary be when she is twice his age?

Solution:
Mary is 16 years old
She is 4 times older than her brother
∴ Age of her brother 16/4 = 4 years

Let after x years she will twice his age
∴ 16 + x = 2(4 + x)
⇒ 16 + x = 8 + 2x
⇒ x = 8

After 8 years she will twice his age
∴ Her age will be 16 + 8 = 24 years

Bank-Special-75.question: ২১) A sum of Tk. 4800 is invested at a compound interest for three years, the rate of interest being 10% p.a., 20% p.a. and 25% p.a. for the 1st, 2nd and the 3rd years respectively. Find the interest received at the end of the three years.
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: A sum of Tk. 4800 is invested at a compound interest for three years, the rate of interest being 10% p.a., 20% p.a. and 25% p.a. for the 1st, 2nd and the 3rd years respectively. Find the interest received at the end of the three years.

Solution:
Let A be the amount received at the end of the three years.

A = 4800[1 + 10/100][1 + 20/100][1 + 25/100]
A = (4800 × 11 × 6 × 5)/(10 × 5 × 4)
A = 7920

So the interest = 7920 - 4800 = 3120

Bank-Special-75.question: ২৩) The quadratic equation whose one rational root is 3 + √2 is-
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: The quadratic equation whose one rational root is 3 + √2 is-

Solution:
one root is 3 + √2
∴ other root is 3 - √2

Sum of roots = 3 + √2 + 3 - √2 = 6
Product of roots = (3 + √2)(3 - √2) = (3)2 - (√2)2 = 9 - 2 = 7

∴ Required quadratic equation is x2 - 6x + 7 = 0

Bank-Special-75.question:

Which day comes next?
Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: SUNDAY, MONDAY, WEDNESDAY, SATURDAY, WEDNESDAY
Which day comes next?

Solution:
SUNDAY
SUNDAY + 1 = MONDAY
MONDAY + 2 = WEDNESDAY
WEDNESDAY + 3 = SATURDAY
SATURDAY + 4 = WEDNESDAY
WEDNESDAY + 5 = MONDAY

Bank-Special-75.exp:
Question: S.I. on Tk. 1500 at 7% per annum for a certain time is Tk. 210. Find the time.

Solution:
P = 1500
r = 7%

n = ?

n = I/(Pr)
= (210 × 100)/(1500 × 7)
= 2 years
